blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, Bohol — Concerned citizens and road safety advocates have formed a coalition in Bohol to address the growing number of road crashes and push for safer and more accessible streets. The Bohol Advocates for Guided Traffic and Safety (Bagtas) was launched on Sunday, Nov. 15, coinciding with the observance of the World Day of Remembrance for Road Traffic Victims. Retired Philippine Coast Guard Capt. Jose Balbino Luspo, Bagtas co-convenor, said the coalition aims to bring together communities, government agencies and private institutions to make roads safer.
